name: image-to-css-art
title_zh: 离线像素转 CSS 插画
tagline_zh: 给一张照片，还你一份能直接嵌网页的 HTML/CSS 插画。不用联网、不碰画布，全靠颜色分割和轮廓追踪。
tagline_en: Feed a photo, get a standalone HTML/CSS illustration. No cloud, no canvas—just offline color segmentation.
desc_en: Convert a supplied raster reference into a faithful, standalone HTML/CSS illustration using offline color segmentation, contour tracing and local gradients. Use when the user asks for pure CSS art, image-to-HTML illustration, or high-fidelity reference recreation that forbids img, SVG, Canvas, JavaScript, base64 and external assets. Requires a local reference image and permission to run offline Py
why_zh: 把位图拆成色块再描边，最后用局部渐变模拟光影——全程离线，产物干净到能过最严的「无图无脚本」审查。
why_en: Decomposes raster into color regions, traces contours, fakes shading with local gradients—all offline, clean enough for strict.
limit_zh: 只认本地图片路径，且必须允许跑离线 Python 环境。输出是静态 HTML/CSS，不含动画或交互。
limit_en: Requires a local image path and permission to run offline Python. Output is static HTML/CSS—no animation or interaction; complex photos lose detail.
title_en: Offline raster-to-CSS art, no img/SVG/JS allowed
